metaTitle: SPEND: Split group bills and track travel costs
metaDescription: Record shared expenses, choose who paid and who shares each cost, and review suggested settlements. SPEND is available for iPhone and Android.

title: Split group bills.
Track travel costs.
hero.body: Choose who paid and who shares each expense, then see who owes whom.

featuresIntro: Keep the record clear from the first expense to the final settlement.

features.title: Some costs for two, others for everyone
features.body: Choose who shares each expense. Split equally, set member share ratios or enter individual amounts. Record costs paid by more than one person, too.

features.title: See who owes whom
features.body: Review member balances and suggested settlements at a glance. Share the settlement results so your group can check them after a meetup or trip.

features.title: Local spending, familiar currency
features.body: Record expenses in the local currency and review them in your usual currency. Enter an exchange rate yourself or look one up.

features.title: Keep each trip and meetup separate
features.body: A weekend away, a gathering with friends or a shared meal. Organize expenses into separate events and add dates, places and notes. Find records by category or tag.

features.title: Look back at spending and keep your records
features.body: Review spending over time and by category or tag. Export transactions as CSV to view them in Excel, or back up and restore all your records.

features.title: Just need to split a bill?
features.body: Enter amounts and a headcount without creating an event. Add several amounts, reopen recent calculations and edit them. Move a calculation into a new event when you want to keep recording.

features.title: Mini games for your meetup
features.body: Open the finger, wheel and pinball games from Easy Split or the transaction list.

guidesIntro: Three everyday situations, with a clear record of who paid and who shares the cost.

guides.title: Only two people shared this cost
guides.body: Choose who took part in each expense. A group trip can include costs shared by different people.
steps: Add the expense to your event and record who paid.
Select only the members who share this expense. Split equally, use ratios or enter individual amounts.
Review the event balances after adding the rest of your costs.
guides.example: Four friends are traveling together. Only two share a cost of 60. With an equal split, those two share 30 each; the other two share 0 of this expense.

guides.title: Different people paid along the way
guides.body: Record each payment and each member’s share as you go. SPEND brings them together to show each member’s balance.
steps: Create an event and add the people in your group.
Record each expense with its payer and participants. If more than one person paid a single expense, record their contributions.
Check member balances and suggested settlements, then share the result.
guides.example: Four people share 180 equally, so each person’s share is 45. A paid 120 and B paid 60. Their balances are A +75, B +15, C −45 and D −45. Suggested settlements show how to balance the record.

guides.title: Keep travel costs in the local currency
guides.body: Record what you actually spent in the local currency and review costs in your usual currency.
steps: Choose the currency when you record an expense.
Enter an exchange rate or retrieve one in the app. Check the amount and rate used for your record.
Review the converted amounts and group balances in your chosen currency.
guides.example: If a trip includes more than one currency, keep each expense’s original currency and review its conversion. Exchange rates can change, so check the rate used for each record.

faqs.question: Can each expense have different participants?
faqs.answer: Choose the members who share each expense, then split equally, use ratios or enter individual amounts. You can record different participants for each cost within the same event.

faqs.question: Can I share expenses and settlement results?
faqs.answer: Share expense details and settlement results so your group can review them together. Live sharing and sync are planned for future updates.

faqs.question: Can I keep a copy of my records?
faqs.answer: You can export transactions as CSV to view them in Excel, and back up and restore all your records.

roadmapItems.title: Live sharing and sync

roadmapItems.title: Advanced statistics
roadmapItems.body: Discover patterns in your spending and travel records.

roadmapItems.title: Photos and maps
roadmapItems.body: Bring each trip to life with photos and places on a map.
